Oriente Medio y la política de seguridad estadounidense registran importantes novedades en una jornada marcada por la reactivación de las tensiones energéticas y diplomáticas. En Arabia Saudí, los rebeldes de Yemen han asegurado haber atacado infraestructuras petroleras clave de la empresa estatal Aramco en Abqaiq y estaciones del oleoducto Este-Oeste, mientras las autoridades saudíes confirmaron un incendio previo en el trazado de Medina ya extinguido sin víctimas ni parálisis en el suministro de crudo.

🚨🇨🇺 CUBA EN CRISIS: EL PESO PIERDE VALOR, EL TURISMO SE DESPLOMA Y LAS HOTELERAS SE RETIRAN

La economía cubana atraviesa una profunda crisis marcada por la pérdida de valor del peso, la caída del turismo y las dificultades financieras que afectan a empresas extranjeras con operaciones en la isla.

🏨 La cadena española Meliá mantiene sus 34 hoteles en Cuba clasificados como operaciones interrumpidas, con un impacto financiero cercano a los 80 millones de euros.

📉 Entre enero y septiembre de 2026, Cuba recibió apenas 477.707 visitantes internacionales, una caída de aproximadamente el 65 % respecto al mismo período del año anterior.

💰 Mientras tanto, el economista Pedro Monreal advierte de un deterioro preocupante en la distribución del ingreso: la participación de los salarios en el PIB cubano cayó de aproximadamente el 55 % al 25 % tras la implementación de la Tarea Ordenamiento.

🎙️ Conversamos con el economista **Carlos Martínez** sobre las causas de esta crisis, el papel de GAESA, las sanciones estadounidenses, las decisiones económicas del Gobierno y las consecuencias para los cubanos.

snippet.title: POV: You Think They Won’t Find Anything
snippet.description:
Sources- PMID 34100160 
Maya on TT 

Sjögren's disease is an autoimmune condition where the immune system mistakenly attacks moisture-producing glands, leading to symptoms like dry eyes and a dry mouth. It affects some people and not others largely due to a combination of genetics and biological factors. Certain individuals inherit specific gene variations that make their immune system more prone to misfiring. Hormones and biological sex also play a major role, as the condition is roughly nine times more common in women than in men and typically develops after the age of 40. However, carrying these genetic traits alone is usually not enough to cause the disease, as an environmental trigger is often needed to set it off. Researchers believe that a routine viral or bacterial infection can sometimes act as a spark, confusing a genetically susceptible immune system into attacking healthy tissue. People who already live with another autoimmune condition, such as rheumatoid arthritis or lupus, are also significantly more likely to develop Sjögren's disease because their immune system is already overactive. 

#women #autoimmune #sjogrens

snippet.title: What If You And Your Crush Were Alone On A Desert Island?
snippet.description:
What if you and your crush were alone on a desert island? No phones. No parents. Just the two of you, one cracked kayak, one emergency flare, and a four-metre crocodile who thinks the island belongs to him.

The wind pushes your kayak out to sea all night, and at six in the morning it cracks on a rock in front of a tiny green island. Sitting in the front is Ruby Cole. Your mums are best friends, she pushed you into a pool when you were six, and she hasn't spoken to you since Year Seven. You've had a crush on her for two years.

Thirty-nine days. Coconuts that go straight through you, one toilet called "behind the big rock", a gang of monkeys that steal your only flare, a storm, a sea urchin, and a boat made from a kayak, two logs and eleven hair ties. And every afternoon at ten past four, a plane that never waves back.

snippet.description:
BREAKING: An American serviceman has been arrested by British counter-terror police on suspicion of spying for Russia.

The Metropolitan Police confirmed the arrest was made following an investigation from Counter Terrorism Policing and US authorities, including the FBI.

The 41-year-old man was arrested near Gloucester on suspicion of offences under Section 1 and Section 3 of the National Security Act 2023.

The sections relate to obtaining or disclosing protected information and assisting a foreign intelligence service.

The force confirmed officers are carrying out searches in two Gloucestershire locations as part of the probe.

The investigation is not linked to any other ongoing Counter Terrorism Policing investigations, the Met confirmed.
